limits: The 753 no-row classification follows the source counter's sentinel behavior; there is no dedicated unattributed-Term counter. The ambiguous-ID Term counts are aggregated under colliding local indices and must not be read as per-rule costs. This post-hoc analysis explains attribution accounting, not the application-level origin of each evaluation.

source_interpretation.candidate: cand_tested increments globally. When a rule audit ID is missing, identity-mismatched, or marked ambiguous, cand_tested increments cand_tested_unattributed; on metadata collision, prior candidate_tests attribution for that ID is removed.
source_interpretation.inference: The repeated 753 count is global Term evaluations with no per-rule row, consistent with Term evaluations outside an active CURRENT_RULE context. The 1,708 evaluations under nine ambiguous IDs have no unique rule identity. Thus only the unambiguous-ID subtotal is safely attributable to a named rule in this capture.
source_interpretation.terms: term_eval increments global and per-rule term counters through per_rule_bump. per_rule_bump returns without recording when CURRENT_RULE is the NO_RULE sentinel. A rule ID marked ambiguous does not cause term_evaluations rows to be withdrawn on metadata collision.
